svg.text: Numbers are physical Pico header pins (1-40); GPxx are RP2040 GPIO numbers. Internal pull-ups on all inputs; switches close to GND.
(RP2040 / Pico W) - top view, USB up
Source of truth: README "Wiring / pin map" and the #define PIN_* values in src/.
Display LED+ is driven directly from GP22 PWM; check your module's backlight current / series resistor.
